name: claude-code-hooks
description: Production-ready Claude Code hooks, each installable on its own as a plugin.

plugins.name: context-hogs
plugins.description: Per-file context-cost leaderboard: attributes every tool result's tokens to the files it loaded, so you know which files cost you the most.

plugins.name: nerf-receipts
plugins.description: A personal flight recorder for Claude Code quality: records your own per-session failure rate, edit churn, and tokens/task by model version, and flags real shifts when a model changes.

plugins.name: dead-rules-audit
plugins.description: CLAUDE.md compliance scorecard: tallies which rules Claude actually follows vs ignores as you edit, and flags chronically-ignored rules to promote into a deterministic hook.

plugins.name: pr-provenance-stamp
plugins.description: Stamps a provenance receipt (prompts, estimated spend, tests run with exit codes, and a truthful agent-authored line split) into your PR body on `gh pr create`.

plugins.name: standup-autopilot
plugins.description: Writes your daily standup from what your agents actually did across repos: captures tasks, tests, PRs, and blockers from session transcripts and re-injects yesterday's open blockers next session.

plugins.name: dead-end-registry
plugins.description: Remembers approaches you tried and reverted (with reason and estimated token cost) and warns before you retry them, via a prompt-submit card and an ask-before-edit guard.

plugins.name: bounty-board
plugins.description: Prices your repo's TODO/FIXME/HACK debt as aging XP bounties, injects the top 3 as opportunistic side quests, and verifies + pays out bounties you genuinely clear.

plugins.name: block-dangerous-commands
plugins.description: PreToolUse guard for Bash: blocks dangerous shell commands (rm -rf ~, fork bombs, curl|sh, force push to main) before they run, with three safety levels and opt-in per-level ask mode.

plugins.name: protect-secrets
plugins.description: Secrets firewall for tool calls: denies (or asks, per level) any Read/Edit/Write/Bash that would read, modify, or exfiltrate .env files, SSH keys, cloud credentials, or keystores, with tiered safety levels tunable via HOOK_SAFETY_LEVEL.

plugins.name: git-safety
plugins.description: Branch-aware git guardrails plus destructive gh CLI protection: denies pushes to main/master, protected-branch deletion, direct commit/merge/rebase/reset/push on a protected branch, and gh pr merge/close, issue close, release and repo delete.

plugins.name: protect-tests
plugins.description: Stops "fake green" test-gaming: blocks the agent from deleting, renaming-away, or skip/xfail-disabling tests so it fixes the code instead, across pytest, jest, Go, JUnit, RSpec, and more.

plugins.name: case-insensitive-guard
plugins.description: Stops `rm -rf content` destroying `Content` on case-insensitive filesystems (APFS/exFAT/NTFS): resolves the real target of destructive commands through cd chains, quotes, and subshells, and denies provable case collisions.

plugins.name: config-guard
plugins.description: Who guards the guards: blocks the agent from tampering with its own guardrail config (settings.json, hook scripts, hooks.json, .mcp.json, plugin manifests, claude CLI config writes); reads always pass.

plugins.name: config-watch
plugins.description: Tripwire for out-of-band config changes: warns on every mid-session settings/skills change (or blocks it with CONFIG_WATCH_BLOCK=true) to catch installer scripts and npm payloads rewriting settings behind Claude Code's back.

plugins.name: auto-stage
plugins.description: Automatic git staging: runs `git add` on every file Claude edits or writes, so `git status` always shows exactly what Claude touched and pre-commit review needs no manual staging.

plugins.name: format-code
plugins.description: Auto-formats files the moment Claude writes them: ruff for Python, prettier for JS/TS/JSON/MD/YAML/HTML, with shell-injection-safe argv execution and silent skips for everything else.

plugins.name: session-logger
plugins.description: Durable markdown log of every session (cwd, git repo, files touched, secret-redacted bash commands), appended async so logging never blocks Claude.

plugins.name: instructions-audit
plugins.description: Prompt-injection tripwire for CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules files: flags invisible-Unicode smuggling, secret read/exfil directives, curl|sh, decode-and-execute, and hook/settings tampering as instructions load, then locks the session (every prompt and tool call denied) until a human clears it.

plugins.name: notify-permission
plugins.description: Slack alerts when Claude Code needs you: posts a rich card (project, session, and what needs approval) to your webhook on permission, idle, and choice prompts.

plugins.name: guard-pack
plugins.description: All six guard hooks in one Node process: config-guard, block-dangerous-commands, protect-secrets, protect-tests, git-safety, and case-insensitive-guard, first blocking verdict wins. One ~35 ms Node startup per tool call instead of six. Do not install alongside the individual guard plugins.
